body.message:
Hello! I receive a massage from bank now, there are little mistake in the transfer. Sending your bank massage: 

Roman Olegovich, good evening!

We are contacting you regarding your incoming SWIFT transfer for the amount of 2861 AED. The amount has been received by our bank, however, when sending the transfer, the incorrect account number was indicated - KZ29551B629357374. 
For the transfer to be credited, it is necessary to clarify (re-send) from the sender's bank to this transfer with the correct number - KZ29551B629357374AED. 

Could you please tell me if the sender will provide an update?
